_comment: Race strategy card. compounds: grip x and wear x per compound (the log10 wear cliff stays; softs reach it sooner); lifeLaps = about how many Oxford laps a set lasts to the AI's pit threshold at wear x 1 (the AI's estimate when picking; npm run strategy-probe measures it). defaultCompound: what a car starts on unless its build says otherwise. pitBoard: fuelStepKg = one press of fuel - / + on the pit board. service: tyreChangeSec = a tyre change (all four, alongside refuelling: the stop takes the longest of tyres, fuel and repair). fuelEndMarginLaps: 'fuel to the end' adds this much spare. raceLength 'matched': fuel burn and tyre wear x refLaps / race laps (never below 1), so a short race still needs a stop or saving; 'off' = normal rates. ai: the AI starts on a compound whose life covers raceLaps x startStintShare (seeded pick between the best two), and at a stop takes the grippiest compound that lasts the laps left.
